def parse_section(s, label, stop):
    start=s.index(label)
    end=s.index(stop,start)
    sec=s[start:end]
    lines=[]
    for line in sec.splitlines()[1:]:
        z=line.strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r'\d+(?: \d+)*',z): lines.append([int(x) for x in z.split()])
    return lines
